title: Chirality from exhaustive proper-map comparison
description:
Chirality is equivalent to failure of every proper map to an explicitly constructed reflection, and survives every uniquely labelled branch extension under the stated source conditions.

Maria Smith derives complete finite-map enumeration, reflection involution, element/bond/orientation restriction, enantiomer-pair symmetry and explicit observation records. Includes both complete 256-candidate source grammars, sealed IUPAC source correspondence, 360 empty-axiom audited native declarations, pinned V3/V4 proofs and portable reproduction of 1,352 reflection and 4,056 branch comparisons.

Correspondence: Maria.smith.sftoe@gmail.com. SFT community and invitation: https://discord.gg/QCNkzq6kZC.
